name: True IDC Myanmar (MICT Park)
developer: True IDC Myanmar Co., Ltd (Ascend Group)
notes: First commercial data center in Myanmar, established 2015; Building 17, Ground Floor, MICT Park, Hlaing Township, Yangon. Operator page (A) confirms colo/managed services; PeeringDB facility 5031 (A) maps MMIX Yangon exchange to this facility. SLA/certification marketing claims (Uptime, ISO/IEC 20000-1, PCI DSS) are B-grade until certificates verified. Do not double count MMIX Yangon as a separate DC.

name: MICT Data Center (MICTDC)
developer: Myanmar ICT Development Corporation (MICTDC) with NTT
notes: MICTDC operator page (A) confirms Main Building, ICT Park, Universities' Hlaing Campus, Hlaing Township, Yangon; claims Tier III and up to 162 racks with Japanese expert support (capacity/Tier are B until third-party certification verified). Uptime Institute awards list page names MICT Data Center, Yangon. NTT Myanmar partnership noted for MICT Park DC services.

name: MPT Data Center Hantharwady / Bayintnaung
notes: MPT official page (A) confirms data center service in Yangon (Hantharwady; Bayintnaung new and ready to provide service) with colocation features; MPT Cloud IaaS is hosted at a Myanmar data center (A service existence). Contractor project list (C/B) corroborates 'KSGM-MPT, Data Centre Upgrading Project (Hantharwady, Yangon)' power works. Capacity/power not public.

name: Mytel Data Center
notes: Viettel Family news (B+, parent-company source) reports opening on 2023-08-26 in Yangon of what it calls Myanmar's largest data center: Tier 3-standard claim, 600 racks expandable to 1,000. Capacity/Tier are claims, not certified (B until Uptime/engineering evidence). Exact address not named in the article.

name: Zenlayer Yangon service presence
notes: Zenlayer official page (A-) confirms service availability in Yangon (bare metal / cloud connect); netify (C/B) lists Zenlayer PoP in Yangon. Physical host facility is not disclosed; treat as service/PoP presence inside another facility, do not double count as a separate DC (B/C for host inference).

name: Burst Myanmar / Thilawa SEZ Datacenter
notes: Thilawa SEZ, Thanlyin/Kyauktan area, Yangon Region. DCD (B) and 1-Net press release (B) report Burst's data center at Thilawa SEZ and a 1-Net operational-support deal; Burst claims a 50-year lease on 5,007 sqm in Zone A and a Tier IV datacenter under construction (C via directory text; Tier IV 'certified' claim in 1-Net release unverified). Current operational status not confirmed; stays construction/lead grade.

name: MTG DC (Dekkhinathiri)
developer: MTG DC Co., Ltd (Myanmar Technology Gateway)
notes: DICA official field-visit record (A, 2019-08-29) confirms MTG DC's data center and related services at Dekkhinathiri Township, Nay Pyi Taw, monitored as an MIC-permitted investment project. MTG colocation services page (A) lists NayPyiTaw MTGDC colocation pricing/features. Capacity/power not public.

name: MPT Data Center Dekkhina
notes: MPT official page (A) confirms data center service in Naypyitaw (Dekkhina). Contractor project list (C/B) corroborates 'KSGM-MPT, Data Centre Upgrading Project (Naypyitaw)' power works. Capacity/power not public.

name: e-Government Integrated Data Center (e-GIDC)
developer: Government of Myanmar (MOTC / ITCSD PMU), funded by German BMZ, implemented by GIZ and Catalpa International
notes: Project Bank profile PB-ID-1126 (A) describes a main national data center in Naypyidaw plus a disaster recovery center in Yangon; MOTC published a consulting-services contract award for e-GIDC (A). Government project at approved/planned stage; implementation/operational status not publicly confirmed.

name: IT Spectrum IDC (DC-2 / MMIX Naypyidaw POP)
notes: MMIX AGM 2024 deck (A for IXP facts per methodology, archived at mmnog.net.mm) lists IT Spectrum IDC, Naypyidaw as a current MMIX exchange location alongside OceanWave IDC Mandalay and True IDC Yangon; MMIX operates 2 IXPs across Yangon/Mandalay/Naypyitaw with ~140 Gbps aggregate traffic. B-grade until an operator/government page names the facility directly.

name: Ocean Wave IDC / MMIX Mandalay
developer: Ocean Wave Communication / Myanmar Internet Exchange (MMIX)
notes: MMIX AGM 2024 deck (A for IXP facts) names OceanWave IDC, Mandalay as MMIX exchange location; datacentermap (C) lists MMIX Mandalay hosted at Ocean Wave IDC; Peering Asia deck (C/B) adds an 'MMC DC, Mandalay' lead. Facility existence B until an archived official MMIX/operator page gives exact address and status.
